posts.title: Web Game of the Day: 20 Second Mechanic
posts.description: You don’t have much time? Me neither so let’s make this short: 20 Second Mechanic is a game where you have to fix a machine in 20 seconds top. No more no less. Can you manage to go through all those Wario Ware-esque minigames before everything blows up? You can play the game here.
